name: dprint
description: Skill /dprint:dprint with init (checks for a minimum dprint version, installs or updates dprint at user level after confirmation, offers to create a dprint config and to add dprint plugins for file types the project's dprint config does not cover), check [scope] and fmt [scope] (dprint check / dprint fmt on the current directory or a given path or glob; no argument runs fmt). Also formats every Write and Edit inside the working directory, and files changed there by other tools, with the project's dprint config via hooks when the working directory has a dprint config, and shows a toast when it has one but no usable dprint (missing, failing or older than 0.50) (MCP server dprint-hooks; needs node and dprint >= 0.50 on PATH or in ~/.dprint/bin, or npx).
